as_of: 2026-10-06 (live checks run from a real browser on booking.com, agoda.com, trip.com and the official Paradise, Ananti and Nongshim booking engines; occupancy 3 adults, 1 room, currency KRW)
resolution: Most of the shortlisted hotels are sold out, or close to it, for these dates. Seoul (Oct 16/17-21): Somerset Palace (all unit types, Booking and Agoda), Nine Tree Myeongdong 2 (Oct 17-21; it also has no room for 3, so 2 rooms would be needed) and Rakkojae Seoul (Trip.com: 'no availability on or around your dates'; not sold on Booking or Agoda; its sister Bukchon Binkwan is also full) are unavailable. Only Fraser Place Central has space, and it costs far too much: Deluxe 2BR for 3 is KRW 3,344,000 + 10% VAT = 3,678,400 for Oct 16-21 (5 nights), 2,891,900 for Oct 17-21, or about 723-786k per night. That one hotel would use about 90% of the whole US$3,000 budget, so it is out (high confidence). Busan: Paradise's official site shows Sat Oct 24 as unavailable in every room type, and Booking and Agoda show it sold out on all of Oct 22-24. Hotel Nongshim's official site shows no rooms on any night from Oct 21 to 24. Shilla Stay Haeundae has only Sat Oct 24 (family twin for 3, about 417k with tax). Aqua Palace has only Thu Oct 22 (family ondol for 3, about 207k with tax). The only shortlisted hotel with both Fri and Sat available is Ananti Cove, at about KRW 1.29M for 3 people for Fri and Sat with an extra bed (official site; the VAT treatment of the room rate is not confirmed). Paradise is still bookable on its official site for Thu Oct 22 and Fri Oct 23. Its Special Deal rate includes unlimited Cimer spa and ocean-pool access, and a Deluxe City room plus the 3rd-adult fee of 72,600 (Cimer included) totals KRW 1,113,200 for Thu and Fri, taxes and service included (high confidence). Budget-fitting replacements that were live: in Seoul, Nine Tree by Parnas Dongdaemun Family Room (sleeps 3) at KRW 1,736,141 with tax for Oct 16-21, free cancellation until Oct 13; and 4rest Stay Jongno Deluxe Suite with breakfast at 1,475,638 with tax (non-refundable) or 1,872,701 (refundable until Oct 9). In Busan, Gwangalli-Planet16 Deluxe Triple Sea View at KRW 403,434 with tax for Fri and Sat (2-night minimum; free cancellation until Oct 20; on the drone-show beach). Suggested plan: Nine Tree Dongdaemun (1.74M) + Paradise Thu Oct 22 (532k, Cimer) + Planet16 Fri-Sat (403k) = 2.67M KRW. Adding a Gyeongju night on Oct 21 (about 250k, unverified) brings the total to about 2.92M KRW, or about US$2,090-2,180 for lodging, which leaves about US$820-910 for transport and activities. Book within 48 hours; inventory is disappearing.

tips: Suggested lodging set that fits the budget (live prices): Seoul Nine Tree Dongdaemun Oct 16-21 (1,736,141) + Gyeongju Oct 21 (about 250k, unverified) + Paradise Thu Oct 22 Deluxe City with Cimer (532,400) + Planet16 Fri-Sat Oct 23-25 (403,434) = about 2.92M KRW, or about US$2,090-2,180 at 1,340-1,400 KRW per US$. That leaves about US$820-910 for KTX, transit and activities.

More premium Busan plan: Paradise Thu+Fri (1,113,200, Cimer both days), then Shilla Stay Haeundae for Saturday (about 417,000) = 1.53M. Or Ananti Fri+Sat (about 1.29M) if you skip the Paradise onsen and want one resort for both nights.

Paradise official 'SPECIAL DEAL' is the rate to book: Cimer and the ocean pool are unlimited for the stay. Room Only and Bed & Breakfast plans exist too; check that the plan you choose includes Cimer.
Booking.com's search-results page can wrongly label a property 'unavailable' (Fraser did this). Open the hotel page with the dates to see the real room table.
Booking.com prices for Korean hotels usually exclude 10% VAT (shown as 'Excluded: 10% TAX/VAT'). Korean official sites (Paradise, Nongshim) show prices with tax and service included.
warnings: Seoul Oct 16-21 is nearly sold out at the shortlisted properties: Somerset Palace, Nine Tree Myeongdong 2 and Rakkojae (plus Bukchon Binkwan) have no availability. Fraser is available but costs about 3.68M KRW for 5 nights.

Busan Sat Oct 24 (drone show plus LaLaLa Festival Oct 23-25 and Busan Folk Arts Festival Oct 24-25) is sold out at Paradise, Nongshim and Aqua Palace. Fri Oct 23 is sold out at Shilla Stay, Nongshim and Aqua Palace.
Free-cancellation deadlines are close: 4rest Stay and The Prima Jongno refundable rates by Oct 9; Nine Tree Dongdaemun and Fraser by Oct 13; Planet16 by Oct 20; Paradise 5 days before arrival.
Ananti official room rates: whether they include VAT was not displayed. Confirm the final total at checkout before paying.
